about: What the bake needs to know about Boston (PLAN §5). The play extent lives in cities/index.json, the one list the game and the bake both read (K18).

extent.about: The play extent the full bake cuts (D11): its box is cities/index.json's extent, and the play area is the municipalities below inside it. Its gate profile and calib share the id.

municipalities.about: The play area is these four municipalities inside the extent (D11). pop20 is each one's 2020 census count; gate G4 sums POP20 over the blocks whose internal point lies inside the municipality's 2020 boundary (TIGER/Line county subdivisions), joined on full 15-digit block ids, and must match exactly. Counts from census.gov QuickFacts (Boston, https://census.gov/quickfacts/fact/table/bostoncitymassachusetts/PST120223) and UMass Boston's 2020 table (https://www.umb.edu/iaas/census/pop-of-asian-americans-alone-in-massachusetts-2020/), both checked 2026-10-12 through search excerpts.

gates.about: Bake gates per extent (PLAN §5). G1: cells holding residents or jobs. G2: street nodes after collapse, and the share of open drivable km off motorways, inside the box the inputs were clipped to, in the largest piece every node of which reaches every other (motorways and their ramps are left out of the share: clipping strands their ends, and ramps that lead only to a closed River Road are rightly unreachable; the clip keeps whole ways, whose far ends are stranded by design). G3: residents with a kept street within 300 m. G5: residents whose home sub-point lies in water (natural=water or a riverbank), and, where `airport` is set, an airport gateway on its aerodrome; Inner Boston allows 10, because census block 250259815011011 counts 9 people in the Charles River Basin. G6: every street node inside the map file's bounds (the extent plus 1.5 km), and every home, job and listed landmark inside the extent. G7: sim.json at most 1 MiB gzipped. The fixture box holds at most 99 cells of Boston's grid, and clipping it strands one-way grids whose return lies outside the box, so its G1, G2 and G3 limits are its own. Measured 2026-10-13: 84 cells; 87.5% of open drivable km off motorways inside the box kept; 97.4% of residents within 300 m of a kept street, the other 2,748 all north of 42.355 in Beacon Hill and Cambridgeport, whose stranded one-way grids the clip drops.

landmarks.about: Where contracts are offered (the M3 spec, item 1; PLAN §3 Goals): a named point each, baked into sim.json for the extents whose clip holds it, and G6 fails a bake on one outside the extent. Each point is the label the game's own map file draws (boston-20261012-a35f1831.pmtiles, from OpenStreetMap, © OpenStreetMap contributors), read with the bake's tile decoder on 2026-10-13. Kenmore Square carries no label of its own, so Kenmore is the Fenway–Kenmore neighbourhood label, about 150 m west of the square. No transit name is used (D17).

calib.about: Demand scaling per extent (PLAN §3: prices stay V1's, calib.tripScale scales demand). Mini-Boston's is set so the debug line (Copley, Symphony, the MFA, Longwood; every 20 min by day; $2.25) carries 600–1,000 boardings a day, the spec's target beside V1's starter at 1,058 (EC-11). Measured 2026-10-13 at 1000‰: 7,200.7 a day, so 111‰ gives about 800; src/sim/demand/calibration.test.ts holds the band. Inner Boston's (279‰, measured 2026-10-13 by `npm run bench calib`) carries on the debug line what the fixture carries at its 111‰: the fixture's box holds every commute inside it, so at 1000‰ its debug line carries 2.5 times what the same line does on Inner Boston, whose workers spread over all of its jobs. gravityBetaM is the commuter matrix's decay, exp(-d/β) (src/sim/demand/commuters.ts): `node tools/bake/beta.mjs boston inner-boston` fits it to LODES's commutes with both ends inside the play area, measured 2026-10-13 as 3,260 m (LODES's mean commute between cells 3.499 km; V1's 4,000 m gave 3.655). The fixture takes Inner Boston's: its own box cuts off every longer commute, so its own fit (1,240 m) would describe the box, not Boston.

fixture.about: Mini-Boston, Back Bay to Longwood (PLAN §5): every input clipped to this box and committed under tools/bake/fixtures/, so PR checks and the money work never wait for the full bake.

sources.about: OpenStreetMap, one Geofabrik Massachusetts extract (ODbL). Streets, depot land, lane tags, and the transit features the bake strips (D17).
TIGER/Line 2020 blocks for Massachusetts; the .dbf carries POP20, HOUSING20 and each block's internal point.
TIGER/Line 2020 county subdivisions for Massachusetts: each block's municipality for gate G4, and the boundaries the extent polygon is cut from (week 2).
LODES 8.4, 2023: commutes between Massachusetts blocks, all jobs.
LODES 8.4, 2023: Massachusetts jobs held by people living in other states.
LODES 8.4, 2023: jobs by workplace block, with jobs by sector.

LODES 8.4 block crosswalk. A cross-check only: its municipality codes are not 2020's (it puts six populated border blocks, 828 people, in Cambridge and Somerville that 2020's boundaries put in Belmont and Medford), so the bake takes municipalities from the cousub boundaries and reports where the two disagree.
